surfaces.name: AgentsDock desktop app (Electron; macOS, Windows, Linux)

AgentsDock Android app (React Native, beta APK)

claims.answer: Electron desktop app (macOS universal, Windows x64, Linux x64/arm64), iPhone/iPad app on the App Store and an Android beta APK connect to a self-hosted AgentsServer; `agentsdock` CLI manages servers; shared-chat browser page for one chat.

evidence.title: GitHub repository metadata
evidence.finding: 117 stars, Apache-2.0, homepage agentsdock.net, Python, pushed 2026-11-17.

evidence.title: Release v1.0.11 assets
evidence.finding: Stable release 2026-10-27 with mac-universal dmg/zip, win-x64 exe, linux x64/arm64 AppImage and tar.gz, update feed yml files and SHA256SUMS.

evidence.title: README
evidence.locator: What you can do; How it works; Get started; Where things live; License
evidence.finding: Desktop and mobile workspace for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode (Gemini on desktop via API); AgentsServer runs agents on a computer you control; npm install -g agentsdock; Apache-2.0; legacy Swift clients not current.

evidence.title: AgentsServer README
evidence.locator: Features; Prepare the server machine; Install; Connect; Memory at launch
evidence.finding: Server runs on Apple silicon macOS or Linux with systemctl --user; native Windows server unsupported; Node 22.14+, uv, tmux; per-turn 2 GiB and scheduled-job 4 GiB memory admission; Gemini through API connection.

evidence.title: Persistent execution during server updates
evidence.finding: Gateway and execution owner are separate processes; clients reconnect and resume event history; accepted commands are never replayed by the gateway.

evidence.title: Direct desktop release channels
evidence.finding: Releases and update feed on GitHub; electron-updater; opt-in Beta track; Mac App Store/TestFlight use Apple updates; signing and publishing run in separate dispatched workflows.

evidence.title: Desktop and shared-chat usage analytics
evidence.finding: Mixpanel product-usage events with a per-install random ID, fixed backend enum and success flags on desktop; iOS sends none; IP collection disabled.

evidence.title: Desktop analytics consent logic
evidence.finding: Analytics are granted by default without a prompt; an earlier explicit denial is honoured; setAnalyticsConsent is defined but no settings control calls it in this release.

evidence.title: Settings dialog test
evidence.locator: queryByRole switch "Share usage analytics" not in the document
evidence.finding: Test states "The usage analytics opt-out was removed from Settings on purpose".

evidence.title: Website privacy policy source
evidence.finding: Client collects no chat content; Mixpanel events by default on macOS/Windows/Linux/Android; policy says analytics can be turned off in Settings.

evidence.title: Team Hub V1
evidence.finding: Embedded private-network beta.6 preview; not a published production deployment; one designated AgentsServer hosts the Hub.

evidence.title: Cross-chat handoffs
evidence.finding: @Chat references let an agent send or ask another chat; directional grants; incoming work enters the target durable FIFO; text only; scheduled jobs store exact routes.

evidence.title: Async chat routes
evidence.finding: Accepted @Chat creates an exact same-server permission pair; delivery turns get only the reverse member; forks inherit nothing.

evidence.title: Interactive chat shares
evidence.finding: Opt-in sharing: View only or Interactive; collaborator can stop/steer, respond to approvals, manage queue, change model/permission settings and create jobs for that chat; not a provider sandbox.

evidence.title: User questions in no-prompt modes
evidence.finding: Codex approval policy never and Claude dontAsk/bypassPermissions skip native questions without waiting.

evidence.title: Available-memory admission
evidence.finding: New agent turns need 2048 MB available memory; scheduled jobs 4096 MB; overrides by environment variables.

evidence.title: Scheduled job CLI
evidence.finding: Agents create chat-scoped scheduled jobs through a local helper with loopback origin checks.

evidence.title: Shared desktop types
evidence.finding: Scheduled jobs use interval, cron or rrule schedules with per-run route selections and run-history status.

evidence.title: Workspace Git contract
evidence.finding: Changes view: stage, unstage, commit, resolve, continue, abort with expected_revision checks; branch, merge/rebase/cherry-pick operation state.

evidence.title: Gemini provider
evidence.finding: Gemini is built in on desktop through ACP and an API connection with Gemini CLI 0.64.0.

evidence.title: LICENSE and NOTICE
evidence.finding: Apache License 2.0 with NOTICE listing separately licensed components.

evidence.title: Feature guide page
evidence.finding: Feature groups: agent-to-agent messaging, Share Chat with link and token, side chat, fork, resume, terminal access, view/edit code, slash commands, scheduled jobs.

evidence.title: agentsdock.net home
evidence.finding: Downloads for macOS, iPhone and iPad, Linux and Windows; mobile apps described as beta testing.

evidence.title: Desktop app screenshot on the product site
evidence.finding: Real desktop window: Mac Mini server, 17 chats grouped by folder, Codex chat "CLIP and LLaVA" with results, Files & media, session inspector and Jobs.

evidence.title: AgentsDock desktop analytics gate at v1.0.11
evidence.locator: electron/src/renderer/src/lib/analytics.ts L43-L64; electron/src/preload/index.ts L438; electron/src/renderer/src/components/Dialogs.test.tsx L177; mobile-react/src/components/AnalyticsSettings.android.tsx; website/privacy.html L61-L69
evidence.finding: At v1.0.11 desktop Mixpanel analytics are granted by default without a prompt. Desktop Settings has no opt-out (a test says it was removed on purpose); only the undocumented AGENTSDOCK_DISABLE_ANALYTICS=1 environment variable, or a denial stored by an older version, stops them. The Android app has a Usage analytics settings page. The privacy policy still says analytics can be turned off in Settings on macOS, Windows, Linux and Android.
